claim.purpose: Prepare and review Runtime v3 acceptance cards and dependency truth without executing acceptance

initial.title: [v0.91.8][WP-14] Fully accept and deploy Runtime v3
initial.goal: Accept Runtime v3 at an exact revision after all parity, consumer, operational, rollback, and workcell proof dependencies converge.
initial.required_outcome: Runtime v3 is installed through its stable owner path, operationally proven, rollback-capable, reviewed, and consumable by ADL v2 and v0.92 without relying on Runtime v2 implementation paths.
declared_scope: Runtime v3 integrated acceptance and retained proof synthesis
ADL v2 adapter and provider/tool consumer proof
guardian, secure access, Observatory, rollback, and operations proof
authority_boundary: typed C-SDLC v2 records and exact-revision review govern acceptance
initial.task_boundary: Prepare acceptance cards now; execute acceptance only after every declared dependency is integrated and proven.
deliverables: reviewed Runtime v3 acceptance contract and dependency graph
exact-revision parity and consumer proof register
guardian, access, Observatory, operations, and rollback evidence
line-count, module-growth, test-count, CI, and residual non-claim report
truthful acceptance or blocker disposition for #5384 consumption
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: #5591 completes before #5592, #5589, and #5590, and all four parity packets are reviewed and integrated
AC-2: Runtime v3 executes canonical ingress, continuity, checkpoint/replay/resume, and graceful pressure shutdown at the accepted revision
AC-3: Reasoning graphs, loops, affect-control, adaptive learning, governed operations, and secure access have explicit parity proof or blocker disposition
AC-4: #5341, #5349, and #5501 prove real Runtime v3 consumers without Runtime v2 implementation dependencies
AC-5: Guardian, HTTPS local/remote API, Observatory, telemetry, rollback, and recovery proof passes with no hard-coded address
AC-6: Focused tests, strict lint, CI, line-count, module-growth, dependency, and exact-revision review gates pass
AC-7: Unsupported GPU, remote-provider, or deployment claims remain explicit non-claims and cannot be promoted by this umbrella
dependencies: Parity-A #5591 before Parity-B #5592, Parity-C #5589, and Parity-D #5590
non_goals: Runtime v2 implementation reuse or deletion
new feature scope beyond declared parity
initial.plan_summary: Prepare and review the Runtime v3 acceptance contract, wait for architecture and parity dependencies, then synthesize exact-revision operational, consumer, rollback, and workcell proof for #5384.

steps.action: Prepare and review all six acceptance cards, dependency graph, protected paths, and validation lanes
Consume reviewed Parity-A through Parity-D and Runtime v3 consumer evidence at exact revisions
Run guardian, secure access, Observatory, telemetry, pressure, rollback, and recovery acceptance
Synthesize live workcell and consumer proof, review the exact revision, and publish truthful acceptance or blocker state

risks: fixture-only parity could be mistaken for integrated behavior
parallel parity children may collide on shared Runtime kernel paths
Runtime v2 imports could silently defeat cutover independence
network configuration could regress to loopback-only or hard-coded addresses
unsupported remote or GPU evidence could be overstated
invariants: no acceptance execution before dependencies integrate
stop_conditions: any required parity or consumer dependency remains open or unreviewed
protected paths overlap without explicit serialization
acceptance requires Runtime v2 implementation reuse
a required proof can only be represented as an unsupported claim
review_prompts: Does the dependency order prevent fixture-only or partial parity from closing acceptance?
Does every v0.91.7 Runtime feature have a Runtime v3 owner, proof, or explicit blocker?
Are Runtime v2 implementation paths excluded from the accepted boot and consumer surfaces?
Are network, guardian, Observatory, pressure, rollback, and retained-state claims proven at one exact revision?
Are GPU, remote-provider, and deployment non-claims stated without weakening local acceptance truth?

validation_lanes.proof_role: Fail closed unless architecture, parity, consumer, and workcell dependencies are integrated at exact revisions and unsupported surfaces remain explicit non-claims
Run the isolated Runtime v3 kernel test suite
Run the isolated Runtime v3 supervision and component test suite
Exercise guardian lifecycle, health, and graceful shutdown through the owner script
Report Runtime v3 source size and preserve the module-growth budget
Verify issue-branch patch hygiene at the exact reviewed revision

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on missing parity, consumer, guardian, secure-access, Observatory, rollback, exact-revision, independence, or retained-state proof; preserve unsupported remote and GPU outcomes as non-claims.
